title: Milestone 1: Foundation
description: Repo scaffold (Vite + vanilla TS), engine port with RNG state exposed for exact resume, spec load + startup validation, persistence layer (IndexedDB with localStorage and memory fallback; save after every decree and month end; resume mid-run), balance harness as an automated test, Vitest + Playwright WebKit scaffold, foundation status page. Done when: suite green, harness matches ADDENDUM section 3, screenshots at 1180x820 and 820x1180.
notes: M1 implemented: Vite + TS scaffold; engine port equivalence-tested month-by-month against the reference (RNG state exposed for exact resume); spec load + startup validation; persistence (IndexedDB with localStorage and memory fallback, SaveStore envelope, progress-code codec); ported balance harness in Vitest; foundation status page; Playwright WebKit e2e at 1180x820 and 820x1180 with screenshots committed under screenshots/milestone-1. Verification: 61 unit tests green, typecheck green, static build green (65 kB js / 2.2 kB css), original harness via npm run harness matches ADDENDUM section 3. Rulings: work directly on main (fresh local repo, no other work in flight); added reference/package.json with type commonjs so the kickoff harness command runs verbatim under an ESM package; manually installed Playwright WebKit 2359 from the CDN zip into the Playwright cache because the Playwright downloader timed out (network itself was fast). Awaiting Bob review before starting M2.
